body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces functionality to build a full 858-row production index and display eligibility delta, adding corresponding tests, readback documentation, and validator results. The review feedback correctly points out a bug where the generated JSON pointer for `source_visual_receipt_full_row_ref` incorrectly uses the `/rows/` path instead of `/full_row_refs/` due to a difference in the schema of the full production receipts file.
